name: fuse-button

frames.best_why: The Undo state is fully lit with a complete orange ring around the pill, showing the fuse before it burns down.

tagline: An orange fuse burns around a button to hold a short undo window.
summary: A compact action button that becomes Undo once pressed, while a thin orange fuse burns around its edge. When the fuse runs out the action commits; pressing Undo cancels it first.
appearance: A rounded dark panel holds a small white heading, a grey line of body text and a charcoal pill button at the lower right with a small archive icon. In its undo state the pill shows a white Undo label inside a delicate orange ring.
behaviour: Pressing the button swaps the label to Undo and lights a fuse that traces the pill's outline. The line shortens steadily until it disappears, then the original label returns; hovering pauses the burn and clicking Undo ends it at once.
demo_content: "Newsletter cleanup" with the line "12 promotional emails from the last 30 days, 4.3 MB in total."
use_when: A destructive or bulk action where people need a few seconds to take it back.
avoid_when: The fuse adds a wait before commit, so it is wrong for instant or high-frequency actions.
customise: Set label, doneLabel and undoLabel, plus icon, size, radius and colours. Undo window, fuse position and thickness, commit timing, hover pause, settle mode and callbacks are props.
weight_why: One short Web Animations tween on a single outline, with nothing running while idle.

a11y.note: Focus is visible and Escape undoes, but the fuse keeps burning and the undo state is announced only as text.

issues: The charcoal pill blends into the card, so its edge is hard to see until the fuse lights.
polish_why: Tidy and purposeful with a clear fuse cue; the low-contrast pill and small copy hold it back.
title: Fuse Button
